newsitem.title: USA: U.S. anti-lock brake probe ongoing.
newsitem.headline: U.S. anti-lock brake probe ongoing.

text.p: U.S. transport safety officials are still looking at safety issues on anti-lock brakes in certain General Motors vehicles but there has been no change in the status of the investigation, officials said.
"It's an important investigation, one of the largest we have, but there's no change in the status," said Tim Hurd, a spokesman for the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.

News reports Thursday had said the brake probe had become a "top priority," but Hurd said the two-year investigation had not changed. The agency is looking into problems reported by some drivers of GM S/T pickups and Suburban sport utilies.
Nick Lobaccero, an analyst at Bear Stearns & Co, said the probe should not affect sales much unless it leads to a massive recall.
"I don't see this an any sort of problem (for GM) in the short term," he said.
